# Bundled third-party code

These files are downloaded and hash-verified by the original Lamplight build. Each keeps its own license; redistribution requires this notice to ship with the app.

| Package | Version | Files | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [pdf.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) (`pdfjs-dist`) | 4.10.38 | `pdfjs/` | Apache-2.0 |
| [pdf-lib](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib) | 1.17.1 | `pdf-lib.min.js` | MIT |
| [Tesseract.js](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js) and tesseract.js-core | 5.1.1 | `tesseract/*.js` | Apache-2.0 |
| [Tesseract English data](https://github.com/naptha/tessdata) (`@tesseract.js-data/eng`) | 1.0.0 | `tesseract/eng.traineddata.gz` | Apache-2.0 |
| [IBM Plex Sans](https://github.com/IBM/plex) (`@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans`) | 5.3.0 | `fonts/ibm-plex-sans-*` | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| [Source Serif 4](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif) (`@fontsource-variable/source-serif-4`) | 5.3.0 | `fonts/source-serif-4-*` | SIL OFL 1.1 |
